items.title: Ellen Rowe interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 2, 2024
items.q: I wanted something that was maybe a little bit more Blakey-Messenger

ctx.x: Have you ever written anything that’s basically meaningless?

Oh yeah. I mean I think I’ve had a couple what you might call throw-aways that, you know, I don’t write a lot of medium tempo swingers or whatever it might be, I’m just going to write something and then you know you come up with it and then maybe it doesn’t feel like it was, you know, a lot of soul searching went into it and there’s not a lot of passion or deep personal connection but at the end of the day it’s a serviceable tune, you can take it in and play it on a trio gig and at that point yeah, the title…
What did you say the title was?
